headlines.title: Poundland supplier 'will lose millions' if retailer collapses

headlines.title: Portugal signs TAP sale contract with Lufthansa, pledging to keep airline Portuguese
headlines.summary: The government and Lufthansa have signed a contract for the sale of TAP to the German group, which says it will remain a Portuguese airline ; the prime minister pledges to preserve the TAP brand and identity .

headlines.title: The Zangezur Corridor: Regional peace and global connectivity
headlines.summary: The Zangezur Corridor is a test case for the region, writes Dr Matin Mammadli of the Centre for the Analysis of International Relations in Baku in an article for Euronews. It could link Azerbaijan with Nakhchivan, strengthen trade between Europe and Asia, and lay an economic foundation for peace.

headlines.title: Anthropic swings back to operating loss as $895 billion compute bill looms over IPO
headlines.summary: Anthropic’s revenue jumped 47% to $17 billion (€15.1bn) last quarter, but the developer of the Claude AI models slipped back into an operating loss and revealed close to $900 billion (€804bn) in commitments, mostly for computing, numbers investors will weigh ahead of its Nasdaq listing.
